mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 6.0% indicates tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 6.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 950,000 units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and earnings expectations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 950.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 110.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction permits and real personal consumption expenditures signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger forward-looking rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0 and FEDFUNDS is ≤2.2%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a robust labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both UNRATE < 6.1 and PAYEMS > 137500.0, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures above 380,000 million dollars, combined with rising residential construction permits, indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
